text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day in February, as Valentine's Day 
drew near. In the shadows of the giddy 
students—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Something was about to take place.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure about that information?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, there's no mistake. ...I hear 
'that' will hit the market tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
19:00, location is... that usual spot on 
academy grounds. The password is... "Zero, 
Zero, Zero." ...Sounds like this is going 
to be a pretty dangerous deal.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You're right, we can't let anyone get the 
jump on us. Well then, see you tomorrow—on 
Valentine's Day itself.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...I sense a breach of public morals!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Tomorrow night at 19:00, a major 
transaction will take place somewhere 
inside the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"That was the report I received from the 
Disciplinary Committee."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, suddenly appearing before 
the Expedition Support Committee was... 
the Tracen Student Council President and 
former Triple Tiara/Crown Umamusume, 
Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... That must be quite a concerning 
matter for the Student Council President.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However... why share that story with me? 
It seems a bit much for casual small 
talk...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, this is no idle chitchat. ――Let me 
ask you straight to the point.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The password given as, "Zero, zero, 
zero"...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I recall seeing a piece with such a title 
at a goldsmith exhibition the other day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your father was a craftsman, wasn't he? Do 
you have any... idea what it might be?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... It truly pains me that I'm 
unable to be of assistance...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I am merely an 
Umamusume... carrying out her duty.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...True, you are merely an innocent 
student. No, my apologies."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because your talent exudes such a rich 
fragrance, it simply sprang to mind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a great honor. To think that my 
scent left an impression on someone of 
your stature.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course, students who work for the 
academy's sake, who are wise in counsel 
and decisive in action... I listen to 
them, and always keep them in mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As student council president, I will 
always be watching over your activities. 
Please... take good care of things.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In order to live up to the 
President's expectations... I will 
continue to put forth my utmost effort.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That was quite a surprise. I never 
expected the President to be here.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps she only came to cheer us on."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To know that you are always watching over 
me... I am truly blessed.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If it were her... I imagine she wouldn't 
miss even a speck of dust hiding in a dark 
corner of the stairs.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, let's get back to work. Will 
you continue helping me?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's hard to believe Symboli Rudolf 
would visit without any certainty, nor can 
I say Dream Journey has nothing to do with 
it, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Are you thinking about it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"That I might be involved... in some sort 
of major transaction, perhaps."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Leaving it like this?
choice_data_list:
Well, it doesn't seem like a problem, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Meaning?
choice_data_list:
When they really want to keep something 
secret, they wouldn't leave even a speck 
of dust behind.

When they really want to keep something 
secret, they wouldn't leave even a speck 
of dust behind, would they.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Did Symboli Rudolf anticipate that and 
walk away without pressing further...?" 
Thinking that, the sharp and capable 
student council president came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, come to think of it. I just 
remembered.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There is only one thing... that comes to 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Please come to the designated location 
tomorrow. —At 12 o'clock."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day... Valentine's Day itself. 
Arriving at the designated cafe at 12:00 
as told—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It is chocolate. Please, have a look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At her urging, I open the lid... and a 
gasp escapes my lips.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Inside was an exquisite, artistic piece 
of chocolate. Its surface was decorated 
with delicate gold accents."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The intricate, delicate design is 
breathtakingly magnificent. It feels 
almost criminal to eat it...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It makes me happy to see that 
you're so moved.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This here... is a collaborative piece 
created by a certain chocolatier and my 
father.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'm recreating my father's work in 
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's a series we started last year, but... 
it seems to have been quite well-received.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, as it is handcrafted artisan 
work... Being such a rarity, it sold out 
instantly last year.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Some people even showed up later trying to 
drive up the prices... Well, thankfully, 
that matter has been resolved.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We have decided to change our sales method 
on an experimental basis this year.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We've decided on an advance lottery 
system, so only the winners will be served 
here at the cafe.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, that story seems to have leaked 
out somewhere... and through word of 
mouth, it somehow became a mysterious 
password.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The title is "Eau de O." It was written in 
cursive, so it might have looked like a 
zero.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
All the sales wrapped up safely yesterday. 
Nobody barged in or caused trouble... It 
went very smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
So, this is the very last one. I'm giving 
it to you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"If I tell my father that I gave it to 
someone who always takes good care of me, 
he will be pleased as well."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please take your time and enjoy your meal. 
I shall take my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. I must deliver the same to Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
She also loves sweet things. Isn't that 
adorable?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then. —Have a wonderful Valentine's 
Day.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"If I tell my father that I gave it to 
someone who always takes good care of me, 
he will be pleased as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This chocolate was crafted by her 
father... It must be something deeply 
precious to her. Is it really alright for 
me to accept it so casually?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Please, take this.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day holds a special place in 
my heart. Ever since I was little, it was 
a day my mother went all out for...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Giving you such an important gift on this 
day... Please think of it as my way of 
showing respect.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a sense, accepting this is tantamount 
to lighting a fire under myself. To ensure 
that I become someone worthy of it—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. Likewise.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. However, 
please don't worry yourself over it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I gave it to you, after all... Besides, 
I'm not really into sweets that much."
choice_data_list: Still, the chocolate's for you, right?
Still, isn't this chocolate meant for you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The craftsmanship recreated in chocolate 
is infused with the artisan's love for 
their family... or so it feels.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, it is quite sweet. It is 
definitely meant for those with a sweet 
tooth.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It is... a bit too good for me, I think.
choice_data_list: Why not try pairing it with espresso?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I've heard that in Italy, the home of 
espresso, it's sometimes served with a 
piece of chocolate."
choice_data_list:
Maybe... the sweetness is made to match 
that.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we check it out?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It's delicious, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey, with a faint smile... 
seemed genuinely happy in her own way.
